items.name: standalone
items.title: Standalone
items.description: Whether the app runs from the home screen, safe to read during a server render.

items.name: pull-refresh
items.title: Pull to refresh
items.description: WhatsApp-style pull to refresh: the page stays put and a circle follows the finger. Installed apps only by default.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab bar
items.description: A floating bottom bar under the thumb with a gliding active pill. Works with any router's links.

items.name: install
items.title: Install card
items.description: Add to home screen in whatever form the browser supports: Chromium's prompt, iOS's two taps, or out of an in-app browser.
items.docs: Call captureInstallPrompt() from @/lib/install in your client entry, before React mounts: Chromium fires beforeinstallprompt once and early.
